about_the_game:
Step into the Boundscape.

Tan, a boy with a hazy past who wakes in a Boundscape called Sanctuary Valley, a tranquil world of rolling hills and calm. A world meant for rest and comfort. But the longer you stay, the more you see the cracks.

Grow Starlight plants, fish with enchanted bait, tackle platforming challenges, help your neighbors with their unusual requests and earn their trust. This world seems safe and warm, and maybe, just... maybe, it's a life worth staying for.

But beneath the warmth lies a hidden purpose. To break free, you must solve environmental puzzles and mini-games, gather hidden clues and confront your own reflection, literally.

Features

  • A narrative-driven adventure with environmental puzzle-solving and exploration.

  • Mini-games woven into the story - platforming, fishing, memory,  puzzles, rhythm, and more.

  • Discover a variety of scenes: cozy cabins, natural valleys, dark dream worlds, or even a shattered world.

  • Meet memorable casts, each with backstories and secrets to uncover.

Inspired by retro adventures and emotional storytelling, Beloved Bound invites players to solve mysteries, bond with unlikely friends, and face the given choice of staying in paradise or returning to a painful reality.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Any modern CPU found in a typical desktop, laptop
  • Memory: 4000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics hardware with DX10 capabilities
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: On board
  • VR Support: No

short_description: An adventure game about a boy trapped in a mysterious virtual sanctuary. Explore, solve puzzles, and discover the secrets hidden in a world that never lets you go.
